有个后台任务失败了。根据失败原因判断是哪类问题（应用没连接、网站打不开、额度用完: A background task failed. From the error, work out what kind of problem it is (an app not connected, a site that won't load, quota used up, unclear instructions…) and tell me how to fix it. If it looks like a one-off, suggest trying again.
任何能发 webhook 的服务（表单、监控报警、支付通知、快捷指令……）往这个: Any service that can send a webhook (forms, monitoring alerts, payment notices, Shortcuts…) POSTs to this address and the bot handles it.
把地址填进对方的 webhook 设置，用 POST 发 JSON 或文字都行。: Put the address in the other service's webhook settings; it can POST JSON or plain text. The address itself is the secret, so don't share it. If it leaks, click "Get a new address" in the editor.
仓库里有新 issue、PR、评论、发布、Actions 失败时，GitHub: GitHub sends new issues, PRs, comments, releases and failed Actions runs, and the bot handles them. You need admin access to the repo to set it up.
在 GitHub 仓库的 Settings → Webhooks → Add w: In the GitHub repo go to Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Set Payload URL to {url}, Content type to application/json, and pick which events to send. After you save, GitHub sends a ping; when the run history says the address is set up, it works.
任何服务推过来的消息，按你的要求处理: Whatever a service sends, handled the way you ask
看看收到的内容是什么，用两三句话告诉我要点；需要我做什么的，列出来。: Look at what came in and tell me the gist in two or three sentences. If I need to do anything, list it.
Grafana、Uptime Kuma、Prometheus 的报警推过来，先分: Alerts from Grafana, Uptime Kuma or Prometheus get analyzed before you hear about them
这是一条监控报警。说清楚是哪个服务、什么问题、从什么时候开始，推测可能的原因，给: This is a monitoring alert. Say which service, what's wrong and since when, guess the likely cause, and give me the first thing to check. If the alert has already resolved, just tell me in one sentence.
新的报错推过来，Bot 看堆栈、猜原因: New errors come in; the bot reads the stack trace and guesses the cause
这是 Sentry 推来的报错。看错误信息和堆栈，判断可能的原因和受影响的功能，: This is an error from Sentry. Read the message and stack trace, work out the likely cause and what's affected, and suggest a fix. If it's clearly noise (crawlers, known issues), write [nothing new].
问卷、报名表（Tally、金数据、腾讯问卷……）有新提交: New responses to a survey or sign-up form (Tally, Typeform, Jotform…)
有人提交了表单。把内容整理成一段清楚的摘要；是投诉或需要尽快回复的，放在最前面提: Someone submitted the form. Write a clear summary of it. If it's a complaint or needs a quick reply, put that first.
Stripe、面包多、爱发电这类付款或订单通知: Payment or order notices from Stripe, Gumroad, Ko-fi and the like
这是一条付款或订单通知。告诉我谁买了什么、多少钱；退款、拒付这类要我处理的放在最: This is a payment or order notice. Tell me who bought what and for how much. Put anything I need to deal with, like refunds or chargebacks, first.
iPhone 快捷指令、自动化工具用 POST 发一段文字过来，Bot 照着做: iPhone Shortcuts or another automation tool POSTs some text and the bot does what it says
收到的文字是我从快捷指令发来的要求，照着做，做完简短告诉我结果。: The text is a request I sent from a shortcut. Do it, then briefly tell me the result.
不选就是 GitHub 发来的都要；GitHub 那边也要勾上对应的事件: Leave all unchecked to take everything GitHub sends. Check the same events on the GitHub side too
GitHub 的 webhook 设置里填了 Secret 的话，这里填一样的，: If you set a Secret in GitHub's webhook settings, enter the same one here and signatures will be checked. Leaving it empty is fine too: the address itself is the secret
判断是 bug、需求还是提问，给出可能原因和回复草稿: Decides if it's a bug, a feature request or a question, with a likely cause and a draft reply
只有新开的、报告 bug 或故障、或者需要回复的问题才处理；纯通知、关闭、机器人: Only handle newly opened issues that report a bug or outage or need a reply. Ignore pure notifications, closures and bots
看这个 issue：判断是 bug、功能请求还是提问；是 bug 的推测可能原因: Look at this issue: is it a bug, a feature request or a question? If it's a bug, guess the likely cause and where in the code to look. End with a reply draft I can paste as is.
CI 挂了，Bot 看是哪一步、可能为什么: When CI breaks, the bot finds which step failed and why
GitHub Actions 失败了。打开链接看是哪个任务、哪一步失败，找出最可: A GitHub Actions run failed. Open the link, find which job and step failed, work out the most likely cause (code, dependencies, flakiness) and tell me how to fix it. If it looks flaky, suggest re-running it.
有人提 PR，Bot 先看改动、指出明显问题: When someone opens a PR, the bot reads the changes and points out obvious problems

有新 PR。打开链接看改动，用三五句话说清楚改了什么，指出明显的问题（缺测试、破: There's a new PR. Open the link and read the changes, explain what changed in three to five sentences, point out obvious problems (missing tests, breaking changes, security risks), and draft review comments.
发布新版本时整理成给用户看的更新说明: Turns each new release into notes regular users can read
仓库发布了新版本。把发布说明改写成给普通用户看的更新说明：新功能、修复、需要注意: The repo published a new release. Rewrite its notes for regular users: a few points each for new features, fixes and changes to watch out for, without technical details.
issue / PR 下面有新评论，需要回复的提醒你: New comments on issues and PRs; the ones that need a reply are flagged
只有在提问、求助或者在等维护者回复的评论才处理: Only handle comments that ask a question, ask for help, or are waiting on a maintainer
有人在 GitHub 上评论。说清楚他在问什么、急不急，写一段回复草稿。: Someone commented on GitHub. Say what they're asking and how urgent it is, and draft a reply.

RSS、Atom、JSON Feed 都行；填网站首页也可以，页面里写了订阅源地: RSS, Atom and JSON Feed all work. A site's homepage works too if the page links to its feed. Many sites without RSS (Weibo, Bilibili, WeChat accounts…) can be turned into a feed with RSSHub: https://docs.rsshub.app

订阅源有新文章。每篇用三条要点总结，最后一句说值不值得细读；明显是广告、和我关心: There are new posts in the feed. Summarize each in three bullet points and end with one line on whether it's worth reading in full. Skip obvious ads and anything unrelated to what I care about. If nothing is worth reading, reply only [nothing new].

频道发了新视频。根据标题和简介说清楚视频讲什么、适合谁看，值得看的给出两三个看点: The channel posted a new video. Based on the title and description, explain what it covers and who it's for; if it's worth watching, give two or three highlights.

播客的 RSS 地址一般在节目主页或 Apple 播客里能找到: A podcast's RSS URL is usually on the show's website or in Apple Podcasts
播客出了新一期。根据节目介绍说清楚这期聊什么、嘉宾是谁、多长，列出两三个最值得听: The podcast has a new episode. From the show notes, explain what it's about, who the guests are and how long it is, and list the two or three topics most worth listening to.
少数派的 RSS，挑出和效率工具、数码相关的: SSPAI's RSS feed, filtered to productivity tools and gadgets
只处理介绍软件、效率方法、数码产品的文章；纯广告、活动通知忽略: Only handle articles about software, productivity methods or gadgets; ignore pure ads and event announcements
少数派有新文章。每篇用两三句话说清楚介绍了什么、对我有什么用；值得马上试的工具单: SSPAI has new articles. For each, explain in two or three sentences what it covers and how it's useful to me; list tools worth trying right away separately.

隔几分钟访问一次网站，连续几次打不开（报错、超时、页面不对）时告诉你，恢复了也说: Visits a website every few minutes and tells you when it fails several times in a row (errors, timeouts, wrong content). It also tells you when it's back, and how long it was down.
选了“出现”或“消失”时要填。多个词用逗号分开：任意一个出现就算出现，全都不见了: Required for "A keyword appears" or "A keyword disappears". Separate several words with commas: it counts as appeared when any one shows up, and as disappeared only when all are gone. Not case-sensitive
一行一个。计数、时间、广告这类每次都变的行填进来，免得误报，比如“阅读”“更新于: One per line. Add words from lines that change every time, like counters, timestamps and ads, to avoid false alerts, e.g. "views", "updated", "ad"
网页内容变了就告诉我: Tell me when a page changes
任何网页：文档、价格表、服务条款、项目主页……: Any page: docs, pricing, terms of service, project homepages…
网页变了。根据列出的变化说清楚改了什么、对我有什么影响；只是日期、计数、广告这类: The page changed. Based on the listed changes, explain what changed and how it affects me. If it's only trivial stuff like dates, counters or ads, reply only [nothing new].
商品页出现“加入购物车”“立即购买”时提醒（缺货时没有这些按钮）: Alert when a product page shows "Add to cart" or "Buy now" (these buttons are missing while it's out of stock)
商品好像到货了。告诉我是什么商品、现在的价格（页面上有的话），提醒我尽快去买。: The product seems to be back in stock. Tell me what it is and its current price (if the page shows it), and remind me to buy it soon.
商品页上的“缺货”“售罄”不见了时提醒: Alert when "out of stock" or "sold out" disappears from a product page
商品页上的缺货提示不见了，可能补货了。说清楚是什么商品、现在的价格，提醒我尽快去: The out-of-stock notice is gone from the product page, so it may be restocked. Tell me what the product is and its current price, and remind me to check soon. If it looks like the page is just broken, reply [nothing new].
商品页的文字变了，价格比之前低了才告诉你: Tells you only when the product page changes and the price is lower than before
只有商品价格比之前低了才处理；涨价、价格没变、别的文字变化都忽略: Only handle it when the product's price is lower than before; ignore price increases, unchanged prices and other text changes
商品降价了。说清楚商品、原价、现价、降了多少（百分之几），有优惠券、限时之类的条: The price dropped. Tell me the product, the old price, the new price and how much it dropped (as a percentage); include any conditions such as coupons or time limits.

公告页更新了。列出新增的通知：每条一句话说是什么事、跟谁有关、有没有截止日期，和: The announcements page was updated. List the new notices, each in one sentence: what it's about, who it concerns and whether there's a deadline. Put the ones relevant to me or needing action first. If only old notices were removed or the layout changed, reply only [nothing new].
招聘页有新职位: New job on a careers page
公司的招聘页、职位列表有新职位: New openings on a company's careers page or job board
招聘页有变化。列出新增的职位（名称、地点、要求要点），和我背景相符的标出来；只是: The careers page changed. List the new positions (title, location, key requirements) and mark the ones matching my background. If positions were only removed or the change is irrelevant, reply only [nothing new].
考试院、学校的页面出现“成绩查询”“报名入口”时提醒: Alert when an exam board or school page shows a link to check results or register
页面上出现了查成绩或报名的入口。告诉我入口在哪、要准备什么、有没有截止时间。: A link to check results or register has appeared on the page. Tell me where it is, what I need to prepare and whether there's a deadline.
填了的话，页面打得开但上面没有这几个字也算挂了（报错页、空白页、被劫持）。健康检: If set, the site also counts as down when the page loads but doesn't contain this text (error pages, blank pages, hijacked pages). For a health check endpoint, try ok
连续失败几次才报: Failures in a row before alerting
偶尔一次超时不打扰。检查间隔 × 次数，就是最快多久能发现: So a single timeout won't bother you. Check interval × this number is the fastest you'll find out
恢复了也告诉我: Tell me when it's back up
自己的网站、博客、常用的服务打不开时告诉你: Tells you when your website, blog or a service you rely on goes down
